desc: Orlivane washable female dog diapers combine a shorts-style body with two crossed elastic suspenders. The straps are detachable and length-adjustable, with stainless steel attachment clips. A hook-and-loop waist and a tail opening complete the design. The layered construction includes printed polyester knit outer fabric, a TPU waterproof layer, mesh lining and two built-in absorbent terry layers. The diaper is washable and reusable. Choose from Floral Red, Purple Stripe and Blue Sky, each in XS, S, M, L and XL. Measure your dog's waist and consult the size chart before ordering. Manual measurement, allow slight deviation.
b: CROSSED SUSPENDERS — Two elastic straps cross over the back to help the shorts-style diaper stay on during movement. The design uses crossed suspenders without a neck collar.

ADJUSTABLE DETAILS — Detachable, length-adjustable straps connect with stainless steel clips. A hook-and-loop waist lets you adjust the waist closure, and a tail hole allows the tail to extend through.
BUILT-IN ABSORBENT LAYERS — Printed polyester knit outer fabric, a TPU waterproof layer, mesh lining and two absorbent terry layers combine in this washable female dog diaper.

MEASURE THE WAIST — XS 9.8–13.8 in (25–35 cm); S 11.8–15.7 in (30–40 cm); M 15.7–19.7 in (40–50 cm); L 19.7–23.6 in (50–60 cm); XL 23.6–27.6 in (60–70 cm). Measure your dog's waist before ordering. Manual measurement, allow slight deviation.
REUSABLE AND WASHABLE — Choose Floral Red, Purple Stripe or Blue Sky in sizes XS through XL. Select your preferred pattern and waist size for a reusable shorts-style female dog diaper.
